summary: Front desk coordinator with eight years in outpatient clinics, hotels and professional offices. I run patient check-in for a twelve-provider practice, verify insurance before visits, train new front desk staff and keep the waiting room calm on the busiest days. Fluent in English and Spanish.

experiences.description: Outpatient practice with twelve providers, about 180 patient visits and 300 calls a day.

achievements.text: Lead a front desk team of four: build the weekly schedule, cover peak hours and handle escalated patient concerns
Call every new patient two days before the first visit to verify insurance, which cut same-day coverage problems at check-in
Schedule visits, recalls and referrals for twelve providers in Epic and keep the same-day sick slots filled
Wrote the front desk training guide now used for every new hire, covering check-in, copays and phone etiquette
Checked in and out up to 150 guests a shift at a 180-room hotel using Opera PMS
Handled room changes, billing questions and complaints at the desk and on the phone
Balanced the shift cash drawer and processed deposits with no unresolved discrepancies
Greeted clients and routed calls for eight attorneys, taking accurate messages during court days
Logged incoming mail and courier deliveries and tracked documents waiting for signatures

skills.title: Front desk
skills.description: Patient and guest check-in, multi-line phones, de-escalation, cash handling

skills.title: Scheduling and records
skills.description: Appointment scheduling, insurance verification, referrals, HIPAA privacy

skills.title: Software
skills.description: Epic, Opera PMS, Microsoft 365, RingCentral, typing 65 wpm
